tasks-for-retiring-the-legacy-command-la.text: Tasks for retiring the legacy command layer.
Issue 486, remainder. Grouped by the slice of the plan. A task is checked only after the ticket owner accepts its slice.

binding.text: [x] gate-frozen: the gate rows of the gate page frozen with their hash before the commit owner starts.

slice-delete-the-legacy-values.text: [x] roots-deleted: the singular fold value, the three open-datum booking values, their arms, argument records, entry mode and create record.
[x] fold-switch-removed: the switch leaves the shared switch list and both parsers; a command line carrying it is refused as an unknown flag.
[x] compiler-closure: every binding left without a production caller is deleted until the unused-binding warning is silent.
[x] tests-and-rows: tests, corpus rows and snapshot entries of deleted subjects are gone; only rows that carried the switch are re-recorded.
[x] evidence-ported: each test that was the only evidence for a production behaviour is ported and named in the pull request.
[x] consumers-green: inventory, declared checks, documentation and speech companions follow the deleted files.
